name: Tamed Ring
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of the wild. However, instead of granting any benefit, the ring instead imparts a -5 penalty to Survival checks and saving throws against mind-affecting spells.

Additionally, the wearer can be commanded as per suggestion with a successful Handle Animal check.

This ring can be removed by casting remove curse followed by rage upon it which destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of the wild

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
